findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact_info, assess_ai_readiness, assess_seo, assess_ad_tracking, assess_website, request_strategy_session · Private data: get_contact_info, assess_ai_readiness, assess_website, contact_tessa · Public sink: get_contact_info, request_strategy_session, contact_tessa.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact_info, assess_ai_readiness, assess_seo, assess_ad_tracking, assess_website, request_strategy_session · Private data: get_contact_info, assess_ai_readiness, assess_website, contact_tessa · Public sink: get_contact_info, request_strategy_session, contact_tessa

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
